sloka: व्यक्तम् नभः शस्त्र विधौत वर्णम्कृश प्रवाहानि नदी जलानि ।कह्लार शिताः पवनाः प्रवान्तितमो विमुक्ताः च दिशः प्रकाशाः ॥४-३०-३५॥
transliteration: vyaktam nabhaḥ śastra vidhauta varṇamkṛśa pravāhāni nadī jalāni ।kahlāra śitāḥ pavanāḥ pravāntitamo vimuktāḥ ca diśaḥ prakāśāḥ ॥4-30-35॥

translations.english: 'Lordly elephants accompanied by their dear female mates, fond of lotus ponds and woods are out to enjoy the sweet smell of the blossoms of saptachada and excited by passion and longing for sexual union are moving slowly.
